events.name: Vermilion: Flight North
events.intro: A balloon shaped like a Meowth head drifts over the harbor. High above it, three voices clear their throats.

failure.text: "Prepare for trouble!" "Make it double!" A net falls over you, and the sky goes dark. You wake in a field with no Pokémon and no Poké Balls.

success.text: Just an advertisement. The balloon drifts out to sea.

events.name: Flight North: The Bully
events.intro: You wake in a field with nothing but the clothes you stand in. A Spearow screams out of the sky and dives at your head.

failure.text: A Weedle rams the Spearow from behind. It flaps away, beaten, and the little bug looks up at you.

success.text: Something small and green drops on the Spearow. It flaps away, beaten. A Caterpie looks up at you.

events.name: Flight North: The Meadow
events.intro: The Caterpie follows you into tall grass. Two small wild Pokémon are in the way. It will have to do the fighting.

success.text: It squares up to the first one.

events.name: Flight North: Cocoon Night
events.intro: Night falls. The little bug spins itself into a cocoon beside a fallen log. You sit up and keep watch until dawn.

success.text: At dawn the cocoon splits and it crawls out changed.

events.name: Flight North: The Stream
events.intro: A stream cuts the path. Something wet and angry is on the stepping stones.

success.text: Your bug braces on the stones.

events.name: Flight North: Hatching
events.intro: A flock of Pidgey takes off from a dead tree. Your bug feels it too. Something is about to change.

success.text: It sheds its shell and spreads new wings: Butterfree! The flock turns on it at once.

events.name: Flight North: The Trio's Camp
events.intro: Smoke rises from a camp in a dry riverbed. Your Pokémon are in a cage beside the fire. A cat is guarding it, and it looks bored.

success.text: You send your bug in low and fast.

events.name: Flight North: The Venomoth
events.intro: Jessie and James are on their feet. "Venomoth, go!" Your bug is the only one between them and the cage.

success.text: Your bug glows. It will not be left behind. It launches itself at the Venomoth!

events.name: Flight North: Goodbye
events.intro: The Venomoth is down and the trio blasts off with a ping. A shiny copy of your bug rests on a branch and watches. You open the cage, and your own team spills out around you.

success.text: Your bug flutters up beside its shiny twin. You wave. When you look again, only the sky is left.

events.name: Vermilion Harbor Market
events.intro: Crates of salt fish, nets and glass floats. A stall sells anything that likes water.

success.text: The stallkeeper pulls back a tarp.
The stallkeeper looks you over, then waves you to the back. "You, I trust."
A stamped ticket. Do not lose it again.
You wave and move on.

events.name: Harbor Market: Water Goods
events.intro: Everything on the table is damp.

success.text: Sold.
Sold.
Sold.
You leave the table alone.

events.name: Harbor Market: Hero's Stock
events.intro: Under the counter: things the harbor keeps for the people who saved it.

success.text: Sold.
Sold.
Sold.
You leave the table alone.

events.name: Diglett Port: The Fan Club Fish
events.intro: A fisher in a hat covered in fish badges waves a rod at you. "Fan Club rules! Strike the second the float dips, and I will teach you everything I know."

failure.text: The fish slips away. The fisher laughs and gives you the rod anyway: "Practice!"

success.text: The float dips and you strike. The fisher cheers: a fine catch, and a fine rod to go with it.
You watch the Diglett pop up and down along the quay.

events.name: Maiden's Peak
events.intro: Lanterns climb the hillside in rows. A bustling market fills the lower slope, and above it, a woman in a veil is walking up the steps. She glances back once.

success.text: Stalls everywhere. The Tea House sits at the back.
You take the steps two at a time.

events.name: Maiden's Peak: Market Square
events.intro: A huge market: lanterns, shouting, crates of everything. Four lanes lead off the square.

success.text: Rows of paper lanterns and shelves of medicine.
A hall of glass cases, each with a labelled disc.
Traders call from every doorway.
You push on deeper into the market.

events.name: Maiden's Peak: Back Lanes
events.intro: The back lanes smell of tea and warm sugar.

success.text: Baskets of eggs line both walls.
A low door, a warm room.
You hear a laugh somewhere above. You run.
You return to the crowd.

events.name: Lantern Row
events.intro: Everything on Lantern Row costs a little extra, and is worth it.

success.text: Sold.
Sold.
Sold.
You return to the crowd.

success.text: The disc hums. Flamethrower is taught on the spot.
The disc hums. Fire Blast is taught on the spot.
The disc hums. Overheat is taught on the spot.
You return to the crowd.

events.name: Swap Alley
events.intro: Three traders hold up cards: what they will take, and roughly what they give.

success.text: A handshake, a swap of Poké Balls, and the trader is gone into the crowd.
A handshake, a swap of Poké Balls, and the trader is gone into the crowd.
A handshake, a swap of Poké Balls, and the trader is gone into the crowd.
You return to the crowd.

events.name: Egg Row
events.intro: Baskets of warm eggs, a hand-painted sign, and a very old man with a very serious face.

success.text: It is warm in your hands.
The old man whispers a secret to your lead.
You return to the crowd.

events.name: The Tea House
events.intro: An old woman pours tea and talks without stopping. Every third sentence is about a lady in a veil.

success.text: Your whole team sleeps like logs.
"She does not walk on stairs, dear. She walks between them." You write that down.
You return to the crowd.

events.name: Maiden's Peak: A Veil
events.intro: A veil catches on the left railing and flutters toward the left stair. The right stair is empty and dark.

success.text: Yes! You can hear her light steps just ahead.
Nothing but empty air. You have lost ground.

events.name: Maiden's Peak: A Lantern
events.intro: A paper lantern is lit on the right and swings as if someone just brushed past. The left lane is cold.

success.text: Nothing but empty air. You have lost ground.
Yes! You can hear her light steps just ahead.

events.name: Maiden's Peak: A Laugh
events.intro: A laugh comes down the left lane, bright and close. Nothing at all comes from the right.

success.text: Yes! You can hear her light steps just ahead.
Nothing but empty air. You have lost ground.

events.name: Maiden's Peak: A Footprint in Frost
events.intro: Frost prints lead off to the right, small and bare. The left lane is warm and dry.

success.text: Nothing but empty air. You have lost ground.
Yes! You can hear her light steps just ahead.

events.name: Maiden's Peak: A Reflection
events.intro: In a still pool, a veiled figure waves from the left. The right side of the pool shows only you.

success.text: Yes! You can hear her light steps just ahead.
Nothing but empty air. You have lost ground.

events.name: Maiden's Peak: The Summit
events.intro: The last step. The lady stands at the edge of the lantern light with her back to you. She turns, smiles, and the wind takes her apart like smoke. Where she stood, something small and bright is left behind. (If you caught up with her by the lucky turns, she left more.)

success.text: She is gone already. In the grass: a Z-Crystal humming with Fairy light, Fairium Z.
She turned and knew you. Fairium Z, a Fairy Feather, and the Tea House lanterns light one by one below.
You already hold her crystal, so she left three Fairy HMs instead.
She turned and knew you. Three Fairy HMs, a Fairy Feather, and the Tea House lanterns light one by one below.

events.name: S.S. Anne
events.intro: The ship's horn rolls over the harbor. A sailor at the gangway holds out his hand for your Ticket.

choices.label: Hand over the Ticket and board

success.text: "Welcome aboard!" The gangway creaks under your feet.
You step back from the gangway.

events.name: S.S. Anne: Lower Deck, Cabin 1
events.intro: Lower Deck. A sailor blocks the corridor. "Nobody gets past without a battle."

success.text: The ship rocks gently.

events.name: S.S. Anne: Trade Offers 1
events.intro: After the fight, two passengers lean out of their doors with Poké Balls in their hands.

choices.label: Trade A: a Kanto Pokémon of similar strength

success.text: Even trade. The passenger hands over a new friend.
"Oh, a lovely one! I have just the thing." Same level, kept item.

want.label: a Pokémon with a regional form

choices.label: Trade B: any Pokémon for a regional one

success.text: "Anything will do. Here, take this one."
You wave and keep walking.

events.name: S.S. Anne: The Galley
events.intro: The ship's chef waves a ladle. "Sit, sit! I will feed you something special."

success.text: He disappears into the steam.

events.name: S.S. Anne: Spicy Curry
events.intro: The chef serves spicy curry. It smells amazing.

success.text: Delicious. Your team is healed and feels ready for anything.

events.name: S.S. Anne: Citrus Salad
events.intro: The chef serves citrus salad. It smells amazing.

success.text: Delicious. Your team is healed and feels ready for anything.

events.name: S.S. Anne: The Stowaways
events.intro: A barrel in the corner is humming "Prepare for trouble". The lid pops off: Jessie, James and a very flustered Meowth.

success.text: "Surprise!"

events.name: S.S. Anne: The Passenger Duel
events.intro: A rich passenger in a white suit flips a coin onto the table. "Two against two. The stakes are a Premium Ball. Interested?"

success.text: He smiles. "Excellent."
You tip an imaginary hat.

events.name: S.S. Anne: The Pokémon Cup
events.intro: The deck has been cleared for a tournament: three rounds, one winner, and a Rare Candy on a velvet cushion.

success.text: Round one.
The crowd roars.

events.name: S.S. Anne: The Captain
events.intro: The captain lies in his cabin, green around the gills. "Please... my back."

failure.text: You press too hard. He yelps, then laughs and waves you toward the gangway.

success.text: He sighs. "That is much better. Take this, with my thanks."

events.name: S.S. Anne: The Rival on the Gangway
events.intro: On the way off the ship, someone steps into the sun in front of you. Your rival, arms folded. "You did not think I would let you leave without a battle?"

success.text: A full battle on the open deck.

events.name: S.S. Anne: The Network Machine
events.intro: The captain, a little less green, sends a deckhand running after you with a box. A single-use machine that can teach one Pokémon any move it could ever learn.

success.text: You hold the Network Machine. It is warm, and humming.
